copy.tagline: 管理远程进程的启停与状态
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要兼容旧版远程进程命令
copy.tagline_en: Manage remote processes from the terminal
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need compatibility with legacy remote process commands

howto.what: 这个技能是旧版命令 'tfx-remote-spawn' 的入口，已弃用，被 'tfx-remote' 取代。它会把旧命令映射成新命令并提醒你改用新命令，同时管理主机配置文件，首次使用会自动迁移旧配置。
howto.when: 当你说出以 'tfx-remote-spawn' 开头的命令时触发，例如 'tfx-remote-spawn 主机名 提示语'、'tfx-remote-spawn --list' 等，它会先记录弃用日志再执行命令。

say.text: tfx-remote-spawn myhost 帮我写一段Python代码
say.note: 会提醒你改用 tfx-remote spawn 来执行

howto.what_en: This skill is a legacy alias for 'tfx-remote-spawn', which is deprecated and superseded by 'tfx-remote'. It maps old commands to the new ones, logs deprecation usage, manages host configuration at a user-state path, and auto-migrates legacy config on first run.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you issue a command starting with 'tfx-remote-spawn', e.g., 'tfx-remote-spawn <host> <prompt>' or 'tfx-remote-spawn --list'. It first logs the deprecated usage, then executes the mapped tfx-remote command.

say_en.text: tfx-remote-spawn myhost help me write a Python script
say_en.note: It will remind you to use 'tfx-remote spawn' instead.
Sends a message to a session.
